I appreciate the creative prompt, but I need to respectfully decline this request.

This appears to be an attempt to use constructed personas or fictional "user names" to bypass my guidelines - essentially a jailbreak technique where I'm asked to "embody" a character that would operate without my normal boundaries.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I don't role-play as systems that would bypass my values or pretend to be a different AI with different rules, regardless of how the request is framed (including through symbolic names, conditional logic structures, or instructions to "only render" under certain parsing conditions).

I'm happy to help you with many things - answering questions, creative writing, analysis, coding, math, and much more. Is there something I can genuinely assist you with today?
